criteria.text: The participant has a histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic or unresectable solid malignancy within one of the listed tumor types.

source.text: Participants must have histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic or unresectable solid malignancy within one of the tumor types listed below (dependent on study part).

criteria.text: In Part A, the participant has disease that is relapsed or refractory or is intolerant to standard-of-care therapies and has no appropriate standard-of-care therapeutic options.

source.text: Part A only: Participants must have disease that is relapsed or refractory or be intolerant to standard-of-care therapies and should have no appropriate standard-of-care therapeutic options.

criteria.text: In Part B, the participant has disease that is relapsed or refractory or is intolerant to standard-of-care therapies. The participant has received platinum-based therapy and a PD-1/PD-(L)1 inhibitor, if applicable and available.

source.text: Part B only: Participants must have disease that is relapsed or refractory or be intolerant to standard-of-care therapies. Participants must have received platinum-based therapy and a PD-1/PD-(L)1 inhibitor, if applicable and available.

criteria.text: In Part C, for pembrolizumab combination cohorts, the participant is eligible for pembrolizumab per local standard of care. For pembrolizumab with cisplatin or carboplatin, the participant is eligible for both pembrolizumab and the platinum agent per local standard of care. The participant is treatment naïve for locally advanced or metastatic systemic therapy (prior definitively intended or [neo]adjuvant therapy is allowed).

source.text: Part C only: For pembrolizumab combination cohorts, participants must be eligible for pembrolizumab per local standard of care. For pembrolizumab with cisplatin or carboplatin, participants must be eligible for both pembrolizumab and the platinum agent per local standard of care. Participants must be treatment naïve for locally advanced or metastatic systemic therapy (prior definitively intended or \[neo\]adjuvant therapy is allowed).

criteria.text: In Part D, the participant is treatment naïve for locally advanced or metastatic systemic therapy.

source.text: Part D only: Participants must be treatment naïve for locally advanced or metastatic systemic therapy.

criteria.text: The participant has a tumor site accessible for biopsy and agrees to biopsy.

source.text: Participants enrolled in the following study parts should have a tumor site accessible for biopsy and agree to biopsy as follows:

criteria.text: In Part B and Part D, a baseline fresh tumor biopsy is required. An archival biopsy collected within 90 days prior to first dose of study drug may be used.

source.text: Disease-specific expansion cohorts (Part B and Part D): A baseline fresh tumor biopsy is required. An archival biopsy collected within 90 days prior to first dose of study drug may be used.

criteria.text: In the Biology expansion cohort, a pretreatment biopsy and on-treatment (Cycle 1) biopsy are required.

source.text: Biology expansion cohort: pretreatment biopsy and on-treatment (Cycle 1) biopsy

criteria.text: The participant has an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 or 1.

source.text: An Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0 or 1

criteria.text: The participant has measurable disease per the RECIST v1.1 at baseline.

source.text: Measurable disease per the RECIST v1.1 at baseline

criteria.text: The participant has a history of another malignancy within 3 years before first dose of study drug, or any evidence of residual disease from a previously diagnosed malignancy. Exceptions are malignancies with a negligible risk of metastasis or death.

source.text: History of another malignancy within 3 years before first dose of study drug, or any evidence of residual disease from a previously diagnosed malignancy. Exceptions are malignancies with a negligible risk of metastasis or death.

criteria.text: In Part D, the participant has untreated, asymptomatic CNS metastases smaller than 1 cm and may be enrolled without definitive treatment as long as they have no neurological symptoms, no or minimal surrounding edema, and no requirements for corticosteroids.

source.text: In Part D, participants with untreated, asymptomatic CNS metastases smaller than 1 cm may be enrolled without definitive treatment as long as they have no neurological symptoms, no or minimal surrounding edema, and no requirements for corticosteroids.

criteria.text: The participant has any uncontrolled Grade 3 or higher (per NCI CTCAE v5.0) viral, bacterial, or fungal infection within 2 weeks prior to the first dose of sigvotatug vedotin.

criteria.text: In Part C and D, the participant has prior therapy with a PD-1 inhibitor, anti-PD-(L)1, or anti PD-L2 agent or with an agent directed to another stimulatory or co-inhibitory T-cell receptor and was discontinued from that treatment due to a Grade 3 or higher immune-mediated adverse event (IMAE).
